question: Who among the following journalists shared the Chameli Devi Jain Award for outstanding woman journalist 2020 with Arfa Khanum Sherwani?
solution:
The correct answer is** __Rohini Mohan.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rohini Mohan shared the Chameli Devi** **Jain Award** for outstanding woman journalist 2020 with Arfa Khanum Sherwani.
 
• An honour given to **women journalists in India is called the Chameli Devi Jain Award** for Outstanding Women Mediaperson.
 
• Chameli Devi Jain was an **Indian independence activist and the first Jain woman** to serve time in prison during the country's struggle for **independence.**
 
• The **Chameli Devi Jain Award, established in 1982,** is a renowned honour given to women journalists in India who have covered subjects like political development, equity, gender justice, health, war and conflict, and** consumer values.**
 
• Indian journalist and author** Rohini Mohan is currently self-employed**.
 
• She won the Chameli Devi Jain Award for Outstanding Women **Mediaperson in 2019.**
 
• The **Seasons of Trouble, her debut book, was published in 2014** and awarded the Tata Literature Live! First Book Award and the **Shakti Bhatt Prize in 2015. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Indian news presenter and journalist Sweta Singh.** She works as an anchor for Aaj Tak and is also the Senior Executive Editor of Special Programming.
 
• The daughter of** Maharaj Krishan Razdan**, the former editor-in-chief of the news organisation Press Trust of India, and a Kashmiri Pandit, **Nidhi Razdan was born**. She attended the Apeejay School in New Delhi's Sheikh Sarai neighbourhood.
 
• Indian author and television journalist** Barkha Dutt.** She currently manages her own digital news station called "MoJo Story" and has worked as a reporter and news anchor for** NDTV and Tiranga TV.** She also contributes editorials to The** Washington Post** and The **Hindustan Times. **
